welcome: PashuMitra pashu swasthya helpline me aapka swagat hai.
language_select: English ke liye 1 dabayein. Telugu ke liye 2 dabayein. Hindi ke liye 3 dabayein. Marathi ke liye 4 dabayein.
main_menu: Pashu chikitsak se baat karne ke liye 1 dabayein. Automated survey dwara samasya batane ke liye 2 dabayein.
main_menu_repeat: Chikitsak ke liye 1 dabayein. Survey ke liye 2 dabayein. Dohraane ke liye 9 dabayein.
vet_connecting: Aapko pashu chikitsak se joda ja raha hai. Kripya line par bane rahen.
vet_unavailable: Is samay koi pashu chikitsak uplabdh nahi hai. Aap automated survey dwara samasya bata sakte hain. Aapki report chikitsak aur sarkari team ko bheji jayegi.
vet_no_answer: Chikitsak ne jawab nahi diya. Aapko survey me bheja ja raha hai.
recording_notice: Yah call record kiya ja sakta hai. Aapki jankari surakshit rakhi jayegi.
recording_consent_prompt: Recording ki sahmati ke liye 1 dabayein. Bina recording ke jaari rakhne ke liye 2 dabayein.
survey_intro: Hum aapse aapke pashu ke baare me kuch chhote sawaal puchenge. Keypad ya awaaz se jawab de sakte hain.
q_farmer_name: Beep ke baad apna naam batayein, ya skip karne ke liye 1 dabayein.
q_species: Pashu ki prajati kya hai? Gaay ke liye 1, Bhains ke liye 2, Bakri ke liye 3, Bhed ke liye 4, Murgi ke liye 5, Anya ke liye 6 dabayein.
q_animal_count: Kitne pashu prabhavit hain? Sankhya dabakar hash dabayein.
q_breed: Pashu ki nasl batayein, ya pata nahi to 1 dabayein.
q_age: Pashu ki umar kitne saal hai? Sankhya dabakar hash dabayein.
q_sex: Pashu ka ling kya hai? Mada ke liye 1, Nar ke liye 2, Pata nahi to 3 dabayein.
q_pregnancy: Kya pashu garbhavati hai? Haan ke liye 1, Nahi ke liye 2, Lagu nahi to 3 dabayein.
q_main_problem: Mukhya samasya kya hai? Bukhar ke liye 1, Khana na khana ke liye 2, Dast ke liye 3, Saans lene me dikkat ke liye 4, Twacha rog ke liye 5, Langda-pan ke liye 6, Anya ke liye 7 dabayein.
q_symptoms: Lakshan beep ke baad batayein, ya hash dabayein.
q_duration: Pashu kitne dino se bimar hai? Dino ki sankhya dabakar hash dabayein.
q_severity: Sthiti kitni gambhir hai? Halki ke liye 1, Madhyam ke liye 2, Gambhir ke liye 3, Ati gambhir ke liye 4 dabayein.
q_eating: Kya pashu sahi se kha raha hai? Haan ke liye 1, Nahi ke liye 2 dabayein.
q_drinking: Kya pashu sahi se paani pee raha hai? Haan ke liye 1, Nahi ke liye 2 dabayein.
q_temperature: Yadi pashu ka tapman pata hai to darj karein, nahi to hash dabayein.
q_vaccination: Kya pashu ka teekakaran hua hai? Haan ke liye 1, Nahi ke liye 2, Pata nahi to 3 dabayein.
q_previous_disease: Kya is pashu ko pehle aisi bimari hui thi? Haan ke liye 1, Nahi ke liye 2 dabayein.
q_medicines: Kya aapne pashu ko koi dawa di hai? Dawa ke naam beep ke baad batayein, nahi to hash dabayein.
q_location_village: Beep ke baad apne gaon ka naam batayein.
q_location_district: Beep ke baad apne jile ka naam batayein. Jaise Pune, Nashik, Nagpur.
q_location_state: Apne rajya ka naam batayein. Maharashtra ke liye 1 dabayein.
q_additional: Kya aap pashu ke baare me kuch aur batana chahenge? Beep ke baad batayein, nahi to hash dabayein.
confirm_answer: Aapne {answer} chuna hai. Sahi hai to 1, nahi to 2 dabayein.
confirm_speech: Aapne {answer} kaha. Kya ye sahi hai? Haan ke liye 1, nahi ke liye 2 dabayein.
invalid_input: Galat input. Kripya dobara koshish karein.
retry_prompt: Samajh nahi aaya. Kripya dobara batayein.
timeout_prompt: Aapka jawab sunai nahi diya. Kripya dobara koshish karein.
survey_complete: Dhanyavad. Aapki report prapt ho gayi hai. Pashu chikitsak jaldi hi iski jaanch karenge. Goodbye.
survey_partial: Aapne jo jankari di hai wah save kar li gayi hai. Goodbye.
goodbye: PashuMitra ko call karne ke liye dhanyavad. Goodbye.
error_generic: Takaniki samasya aa gayi hai. Kripya dobara koshish karein.
callback_number_prompt: Aapka number dikhai nahi de raha. Kripya apna phone number dabayein.
location_link_sms: Aapke phone par location link bheja gaya hai. Kripya use khol kar location share karein.
dtmf_help: Dohraane ke liye 9, peeche jaane ke liye 0, chhodne ke liye hash dabayein.
emergency_escalated: Aapki report ko high priority di gayi hai.
